about: Where the Earth-Moon barycentre is: VSOP87A, heliocentric, cut to 1312 of its 3320 terms.
accuracy: About an arcsecond over the span for the full series (Bretagnon and Francou 1988); the cut adds at most 1.2e-06 au in any coordinate (every dropped term at its largest, added), typically 7.3e-08 au.

sources.text: Bretagnon, P. and Francou, G. 1988, A&A 202, 309: Planetary theories in rectangular and spherical variables. VSOP 87 solutions

input.form: vsop87 crate 3.0.0 transcription of IMCCE VSOP87A

licence: The VSOP87 tables are distributed freely by IMCCE (Paris Observatory) for use with credit to the authors; terms to be read at source by RW1.
